title: Task Creation with Valid Data
description: Verify that a user can successfully create a task with all required fields correctly filled and optional fields as needed.

steps.description: Navigate to the task creation form.
Fill in all required fields (title, due date/time, priority, status, category) with valid data.
Submit the task creation form.
Check that the task is created successfully and visible in the task list and calendar views.
Verify a success notification is displayed.

title: Task Creation Validation Errors
description: Verify that the task creation form enforces validation rules and displays proper error messages when invalid or incomplete data is submitted.

steps.description: Navigate to the task creation form.
Submit the form with missing required fields.
Check that validation error messages appear for all missing required fields.
Input excessively long text exceeding character limits in title and description fields.
Verify that character limit error messages are shown and input is prevented or truncated appropriately.

title: Task Update Reflects in UI and Syncs with Calendar
description: Verify that updating an existing task modifies the data correctly in the application and triggers real-time synchronization with Google Calendar.

steps.description: Select an existing task from the task list or calendar view.
Change task details such as title, due date/time, priority, or status.
Save the changes.
Confirm the updated task details appear correctly in all task views.
Verify that the corresponding Google Calendar event is updated in near real-time.

title: Task Deletion with Confirmation and Sync
description: Verify that deleting a task triggers a confirmation, removes the task locally, and cascades the deletion to the linked Google Calendar event.

steps.description: Select a task and initiate the delete action.
Ensure a confirmation dialog appears requiring user acknowledgement.
Confirm the deletion.
Verify the task is removed from all local task views.
Verify the linked Google Calendar event is deleted accordingly.
Check for a success notification after deletion.

title: Real-time Bi-directional Synchronization with Conflict Resolution
description: Verify that local changes propagate to Google Calendar events and remote changes in Google Calendar update local tasks with proper conflict resolution.

steps.description: Update a task's due date locally.
Confirm the Google Calendar event updates in near real-time.
Simulate or update the same event in Google Calendar remotely with conflicting changes.
Verify that application detects the conflict and resolves it according to pre-defined conflict resolution strategy.
Ensure both local task and Google Calendar event reflect consistent final data after resolution.

title: Calendar Views Render Correctly and Support Drag-and-Drop
description: Verify that calendar views (month, week, day) render tasks and events correctly with accurate dates and times, support drag-and-drop to reschedule tasks, and update tasks accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to calendar view and switch between month, week, and day modes.
Confirm tasks/events appear correctly positioned according to their scheduled date/time and color-coded by category or priority.
Drag and drop a task/event to a new time slot or date.
Verify the task's due date/time updates accordingly in the UI and triggers synchronization with Google Calendar.

title: Offline Mode Task Operations and Sync Recovery
description: Verify that the application supports task creation, updates, and deletions while offline by queuing changes locally and synchronizing correctly upon network reconnection.

steps.description: Go offline by disabling network connection.
Create a new task, update an existing task, and delete another task.
Verify tasks appear updated locally with notifications about offline mode.
Re-enable network connection.
Confirm all queued changes sync to Google Calendar and local data updates to final synced state without data loss.

title: OAuth 2.0 Authentication and Token Management
description: Verify secure OAuth 2.0 authentication flow for Google Calendar connection, proper storage of tokens, handling of token expiration, and UI indication of connection status.

steps.description: Initiate Google Calendar connection via OAuth 2.0 flow.
Verify successful authorization and secure storage of access and refresh tokens.
Simulate token expiration and verify token refresh mechanism is triggered automatically.
Check that the user is not interrupted and connection status remains active.
Revoke authorization and verify application correctly shows disconnected status and disables calendar sync features.

title: Filtering, Sorting, and Searching Tasks
description: Verify that task lists and calendar views support comprehensive filtering, sorting, and search capabilities by criteria such as priority, status, category, and due date.

steps.description: Navigate to the task list view.
Apply filtering by different criteria (priority, status, category).
Verify that only tasks matching filter appear.
Sort tasks by due date and priority.
Verify tasks are ordered correctly according to sorting applied.
Use the search bar to search for specific keywords in task titles or descriptions.
Confirm the search results correctly display matching tasks across views.

title: Settings Panel Customize UI and Notifications
description: Verify that users can configure UI preferences, notification settings, and calendar synchronization options via the settings panel and that changes persist and take effect correctly.

steps.description: Open the settings panel.
Change display preferences such as theme, task list density, and calendar view defaults.
Configure notification preferences for task reminders and sync status.
Modify Google Calendar synchronization settings including sync frequency and fallback options.
Save the settings.
Confirm that UI updates immediately to reflect new preferences without errors.
Verify that notifications respect the configured preferences.
Check that sync settings are honored in subsequent synchronization operations.

title: Security: Input Sanitization and Protection Against XSS/CSRF
description: Verify the application sanitizes user inputs to prevent XSS attacks and includes protections against CSRF in task operations and API calls.

steps.description: Attempt to enter malicious scripts or HTML into task title and description fields.
Verify that inputs are sanitized and no script execution occurs.
Attempt CSRF attack simulation by submitting forged requests for task creation, update or deletion.
Confirm that CSRF protections prevent unauthorized operations and appropriate error messages are returned or user prompts appear.

title: Compatibility Across Major Browsers and Devices
description: Verify that the application functions correctly and UI renders properly with responsiveness on latest versions of major browsers and on mobile devices.

steps.description: Open the application on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari browsers.
Verify that key features (task CRUD, calendar views, syncing) work correctly on each browser.
Access the application on mobile devices with different screen sizes.
Confirm UI responsiveness, appropriate element scaling, and functionality including navigation and task operations.

title: Performance: Load and Rendering with Large Task Set
description: Verify application performance under a load of 100+ tasks ensuring fast initial page load, smooth scrolling and interactions, and quick search and sync operations.

steps.description: Populate the task list with over 100 tasks with varying status, categories, and due dates.
Measure page load time is below 3 seconds.
Interact with task lists and calendar views such as scrolling, drag-and-drop, and filtering.
Verify interaction is smooth without noticeable lag or UI freezing.
Perform search operations and synchronize tasks.
Confirm response times remain quick and consistent.
